description: 避難收容處所開設情形 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 消防署. 將避難收容處所開設情形產生XML檔案 adaptForWeaker：適合避難弱者安置，內容包含：是/否、address：場所地址、 county：縣市、defaultville：預設收容村里、 disastertype：災害類別，內容包含：水災/震災/土石流/海嘯、 isIndoor：室內處所，內容包含：是/否、 isOutdoor：室外... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 消防署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-12-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
